opportunities.title: Research Awards (Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales, Open Research)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; early‑career researchers are welcome; awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree; retrospective applications are not considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, covering archaeology, art history, architectural and building history, material culture studies, history of collecting and related fields.

opportunities.title: Beatrice di Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, William Lambarde Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; early‑career researchers are welcome; awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree; retrospective applications are not considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants supporting research into the material past, with the same scope as the Research Awards, named in memory of benefactors.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants – August round
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based applicants for projects conserving church heritage; applications are made via the Society’s Grants Application Portal.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support conservation work on churches, awarded twice a year (March and August). The August round is currently open with a deadline of 31 August 2026.
